en:
## New Features

- Added Background Tasks Drawer to view and cancel running background subagent and bash tasks from the narrator panel
- Background subagent completion/failure now notifies the parent narrator via injected system messages
- Added "cancelled" tool call status with distinct visual styling (orange badge, ⊘ icon)
- SubagentCard now recognizes manual_override/suspended state and shows a "Resume" button
- Read tool returns image metadata; ToolCallCard renders inline image previews

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed AskUserQuestion compatibility with providers that return questions as a JSON string instead of an array
- Fixed WeChat adapter dedup to use iLink API's msg_id field with proper fallback
- Terminal tool now gracefully handles last_n_lines=0 from AI models instead of erroring
- Bash await/stop control operations now auto-approve permissions (no user prompt needed)

## Refactoring

- Temporarily disabled bash background execution via circuit breaker pattern while retaining infrastructure for future re-enablement
- Extracted coerceQuestions helper for robust question parsing across ToolCallCard and InlinePermission
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增后台任务抽屉，可在叙述者面板中查看和取消运行中的后台子代理及 bash 任务
- 后台子代理完成或失败时，通过注入系统消息通知父叙述者
- 新增「已取消」工具调用状态，使用独立的视觉样式（橙色徽章、⊘ 图标）
- SubagentCard 支持识别 manual_override/suspended 状态并显示「继续」按钮
- Read 工具返回图片元数据，ToolCallCard 支持内联图片预览

## 修复

- 修复 AskUserQuestion 对部分提供商返回 JSON 字符串格式 questions 的兼容性
- 修复微信适配器去重逻辑，兼容 iLink API 的 msg_id 字段
- terminal 工具现在能正确处理 AI 传入 last_n_lines=0 的情况
- bash await/stop 控制操作现在自动放行权限，无需用户确认

## 重构

- 通过 circuit breaker 模式临时禁用 bash 后台执行，保留基础设施供后续启用
- 提取 coerceQuestions 辅助函数，统一 ToolCallCard 和 InlinePermission 的 questions 解析
